question: After config-reload task titles are removed from persisted preflight JSON, should OpenClaw accept this bounded `gateway_restart_audit` table as the restart-specific durable audit surface?
rationale: The PR creates a durable local audit store with actor/source/session/preflight metadata, so the permanent field set and retention policy are a security/product boundary rather than a pure implementation detail.

options.title: Accept narrowed restart audit
options.body: Land the restart-only audit table after the PR removes remaining task text and keeps rows bounded and metadata-only.

options.title: Narrow payload further
options.body: Require a smaller column-only payload with no generic `audit_json` or `preflight_json` blobs before accepting durable storage.

options.title: Defer to broader audit ledger
options.body: Pause this PR and fold restart records into a broader operator audit-ledger design instead.

recommendation.title: Accept narrowed restart audit
recommendation.body: Land the restart-only audit table after the PR removes remaining task text and keeps rows bounded and metadata-only.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner is tied to restart-path history and is the best available routing candidate for the durable audit metadata policy choice.
